next_cursor.description: NextCursor pages forward (older); empty on the last page.

prev_cursor.description:
PrevCursor pages backward (newer); empty on the first page. Pass it as
the `before` query param, never as `cursor` — the two are mutually
exclusive.

records.description: Records is one page, newest first by occurred_at.

call_id.description:
CallID correlates every attempt at one logical tool call (the original
invocation and any retry of it); empty when the call is not a retry.

category.description:
Category is one of: invocation, allowed, denied, customer_retry,
internal, health_check, admin, platform_retry, not_evaluated, support
(Appendix E's `category` column values). The canonical mapping from
the ToolCallUsage proto enum to these wire strings is a #2344
concern: the domain model owns the Decision/Outcome/Category value
objects (their real business meaning and any invariants), and the
app-layer mapper (contracts <-> domain/models, per
enterprise-modulith-modules.md) is what converts a domain value to
this DTO's wire string on export — not this transport package,
which only declares the shape.

decision.description:
Decision is "allowed" or "denied", or "unspecified" for a record whose
Category has no decision (health_check, internal, admin, not_evaluated;
also the fallback for the proto's DECISION_UNSPECIFIED). Not omitempty:
"unspecified" is always written explicitly rather than left absent, so
a decision breakdown (DimensionCountDTO.Key) always has a defined key.

original_tool_name.description:
OriginalToolName is the tool's raw backend-local name, empty when no
reversal was available (no reverser wired at capture time, a reverser
miss, or a record predating this field) — the client falls back to
ToolName in that case.

outcome.description:
Outcome is "ok" or "error", or "unspecified" for a record whose
Category has no outcome (same set as Decision above; also the fallback
for the proto's OUTCOME_UNSPECIFIED). Not omitempty, for the same
reason as Decision.

user_email.description:
UserEmail is the display email resolved from UserID
(enterprise/toolhive-enterprise/docs/design/metering.md),
empty when unresolved (no resolver wired, or an authoritative miss)
— the caller renders UserID's raw UUID in that case. Distinct from
UserID: this is a read-time enrichment, never a stored field.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
